reviews.text: I was impressed by the excellent teamwork among the staff, who communicated with each other throughout the process. Every staff member was kind and coordinated well, making it a veterinary hospital where pet owners can confidently entrust their beloved pets.
The head doctor and all the staff were very kind. I will continue to come here in the future.

It was a terrible hospital.

The head veterinarian's attitude was particularly awful, and I question his qualifications as a veterinarian. The reputation among pet owners I know is overwhelmingly negative. Is it really safe to entrust your beloved family member to them? Those considering going there should definitely read the negative reviews carefully.

I've been using this grooming service for my cat for nearly 10 years, about twice a year. Because she's a long-haired breed, I always request matting removal and a trim to give her a nice, even look.

However, this time, without any prior consultation, most of her fur was shaved off with clippers, resulting in a summer cut. There was no explanation when I picked her up, and I only noticed it after returning home.

I understand that depending on the condition of the mats, it might be necessary to trim her fur somewhat shorter. However, if the result is this drastically different, I would have appreciated a consultation or explanation beforehand.

Previously, due to matting, the entire fur on her lower body was also shaved off with clippers. While this might have been a procedure prioritizing the cat's comfort, I felt that there was insufficient consideration for appearance and adequate explanation to the owner.

Although I've been a long-time customer, I'm now considering whether to continue using their services.

Our cats have been receiving care at this hospital for generations. The head veterinarian and all the staff are always kind and attentive, and they explain the treatment of illnesses thoroughly, so we have never felt anxious leaving our cats in their care. Our male cat, in particular, is grumpy with everyone except me, and I think he causes trouble for the staff every time we leave him at the hotel, but they always take care of him kindly without showing any displeasure. As a pet owner, I am truly grateful to have a hospital where I can entrust my cats with peace of mind. Please continue to take good care of our grumpy son in the future.

I decided to visit the clinic after contacting them for a second opinion regarding my beloved cat.

When I arrived, it was closed.

I checked the time and day multiple times, but it was definitely not a day they were closed.

I called repeatedly from in front of the hospital (was the call forwarded?), and when I finally got through, they said they were delayed due to traffic...
Is that even possible?

It was a hot summer day.

Of course, I never went back after that.

This happened quite a while ago, but this is the kind of animal hospital where such things can happen.

For your reference.

I've received a reply.

The content of this post is absolutely correct.

I was extremely worried about my cat in the scorching summer heat.

The fact that I don't remember is also a problem.

For your reference.

When my beloved dog suddenly fell ill and needed a blood transfusion, our regular vet couldn't provide adequate care, so I rushed her to this hospital as a last resort.

Fortunately, they kindly accepted her, and thanks to a blood donation from the director's own dog, her life, which was on the verge of ending right before my eyes, was saved.

During her approximately three weeks of hospitalization, the doctors and staff provided warm and caring support.

She still receives regular checkups, and I am grateful for the doctors' appropriate prescriptions and guidance.

Noah was brought in for treatment after fracturing a bone. The head doctor and nurses provided excellent care during his hospital stay, and later, when it was time to remove his cast, there was a traffic accident in Tsutsujigaoka, and Noah was being groomed in Akatsutsumi, Setagaya, so I was unable to move. They even went to pick him up for me, which is something I wouldn't normally expect... I'm truly grateful. I'm still taking him to the clinic now, and everyone is so kind, which I really appreciate. Plus, the fact that they're open anytime is a huge help.

The receptionist's attitude was terrible.

I was waiting, but she didn't even look at me, completely ignored me. Couldn't she see me?

If she can't even treat people properly, how can she treat animals? I'm never going back here.

My Chihuahua, who is the most precious member of my family, scratched his cornea when he tried to overturn his dog bed to make it more comfortable. He looked like he was in a lot of pain, and I desperately wanted to help him as quickly as possible. My regular vet is a bit far away and it was closed that day, so I decided to go to this clinic, which I'd noticed on my commute and which is open year-round.

My dog ​​is very timid, especially around male veterinarians, but the head veterinarian was fine.

When I've taken him to other hospitals when my regular vet was closed, he's often taken to a back treatment room and comes back having a frightening experience. Based on my dog's reaction, I don't trust hospitals that take dogs to the back for treatment, but the head veterinarian spoke to him kindly throughout the entire process, understood his timid nature, and treated him carefully to avoid frightening him.

Most veterinarians would insist on putting a cone on a child with a scratched cornea, but this vet listened carefully to my opinion, knowing my child's personality well, and didn't force a cone on him. His cornea healed beautifully with just eye drops.

I believe a vet who listens carefully to the family's opinions and provides treatment accordingly is a trustworthy doctor.

I also plan to take my other pets here if something happens on a day when our regular vet is closed.

Thank you for relieving my precious child from pain.
